title: stainless dome with handle
text: stainless dome with handle. This is just as advertised - a stainless steel dome.  Works great to heat grilled sandwiches without making them super soggy like a flatter lid does - or to heat through a burger or other meat on a griddle.  Easily cleaned.  I hand wash, but I think you could put into a dishwasher as it is stainless - I prefer to hand wash my stainless cookware.

product_metadata.title: only fire Cheese Melting Dome,11 Inch Round Basting Cover with Handle, Stainless Steel Griddle Accessories for Flat Top Griddle Grill Indoor/Outdoor Kitchen, Backyard, Parties Cooking
features: Manufactured with a durable SUS 304 stainless-steel construction and a sleek handle riveted firmly in place, heavy-duty and long-lasting. It's the best essential tool for any backyard kitchen, indoor, and outdoor uses.

With a diameter of 11 inches, it is suitable for various uses and occasions. Perfect for bacon, beef, burgers, poultry, bread, grilled sandwiches, omelets, cookouts, barbecue, caterers, tailgaters, campers, and more.
The stainless steel melting dome can heat sandwiches very well, and can quickly melt cheese on burgers, pizzas, and bruschettas without making them too wet like a flatter lid.
It can prevent the oil from splashing and will not burn you. Easy to clean and can be cleaned in the dishwasher.

A round dome and its suitable size are perfect for concentrating heat to cook evenly, keeping food fresh when they are ready to be served. It produces a dynamic cooking sphere that retains heat and cooks incredibly juicy meals from all sides faster than larger ovens and BBQs.
description: The Onlyfire 11” melting dome is the best essential tool for perfectly melted cheese. Cover multiple hamburger patties and large portions of food with this Dome.
Multiple usages - Great for cooking food evenly, the best way to melt cheese on your hamburgers, omelet, and grilled cheese sandwiches. You can also steam veggies, melt marshmallows, and much more!
It can also be used to trap the smoke of a grill so that foods are infused with delicious smoky flavors.
Manufactured with a durable stainless-steel construction and a sleek handle riveted firmly in place, heavy-duty and long-lasting.
